records.name: Mother Bethel AME Church
records.summary: A historic AME church on South 6th Street that marked its 232nd anniversary in 2026. Neighbors can join Sunday worship in person or online, and the church runs a museum, takes part in holiday giving, and held a Juneteenth community breakfast and celebration in June 2026.
records.what_you_do: Come to Sunday worship, join the 8 am adult church school or the Tuesday and Wednesday Bible studies, take part in the church's holiday giving programs, or book a tour of the Richard Allen Museum (tours by appointment).

schedule.text: Sunday worship at 9:30 am in person and online, Sunday 8 am adult church school, Tuesday 7 pm and Wednesday 11 am Bible study, and daily prayer at 7 am on Zoom

cost.text: No fee is listed on the church's pages

first_step.how: Come to Sunday worship at 9:30 am, in person or on the livestream, or call (215) 925-0616 with questions
first_step.basis: Sunday worship is open to the public, and the church lists a phone line, an email and an online contact form

records.notes: Checked on the church's own pages only. The site has a Ministries directory link but names no food, youth, senior, health or re-entry program. Holiday giving and Children's Church are the only service-type items it describes. Faith set to black_church per the brief; the site does not state it. Livestream and Zoom details exist on the site; meeting codes are deliberately not recorded. The Aug 2026 bulletin PDF is image-based and could not be read as text.

records.name: Enon Tabernacle Baptist Church
records.summary: A Baptist church with two Philadelphia locations: Enon East on West Cheltenham Avenue and Enon West on West Coulter Street. Neighbors can join Sunday worship at either campus, a Thursday night young adult Bible study, or a young adult fellowship that meets the second weekend of each month.
records.what_you_do: Attend Sunday worship at either campus, join the Thursday young adult Bible study at Enon East, or take part in the young adult fellowship, where young adults also lead worship.

schedule.text: Sunday worship at 6:45 am at Enon West and 9:45 am at Enon East; Thursday young adult Bible study at 7 pm at Enon East; young adult fellowship the second weekend of each month (no set dates shown)

cost.text: No fee is listed on the church's pages

first_step.how: Come to Sunday worship at either campus, or call (215) 276-7200 or email enon@enontab.org about the young adult Bible study
first_step.basis: Sunday worship is public at both campuses, and the site lists a phone line and a general email

records.notes: The site's own pages were read; it has no dated items, so status is probably_active. Cross-host 302 from enontab.org to enonbiblewalk.org was followed; the page names Enon Tabernacle Baptist Church and the contact page uses the enontab.org email domain. Faith set to black_church per the brief; the site does not state it. No food, youth, senior, health or re-entry program is listed with times. Camp Adonai's offices are at Enon East, with no program times shown. A staff member's direct email on the site was deliberately not recorded. Building hours are on the contact page and are not recorded.
